lines.en: Will [you come] to my birthday party [tomorrow]?
lines.ko: 내일 내 생일 파티에 와 줄래?

lines.en: I [will] go [to the library] after school!
[There is] a new pen [on the table].
lines.ko: 탁자 위에 새 펜이 하나 있어.

parts.en: So I [won't] go [to the gym] today.
parts.ko: 그래서 오늘은 체육관에 안 갈 거예요.

chat.en:
Okay. Study hard!
I came to the mall.

parts.en: [Are there] many people in the mall?

chat.en:
Not many today.
I [will go back] soon.

en: I [went to the zoo] with my friends today.
There [were many people] at the zoo.
We watched many animals.
I [came back home] late at night.
I had a lot of fun today.
ko: 나는 오늘 내 친구들과 동물원에 갔다.

en: My family visited my grandparents today.
They [live in the country].
I [ran along the river] with my brother.
And we swam in the river.
I [will go to bed] early tonight.
I love the country life.
ko: 우리 가족은 오늘 할아버지, 할머니를 방문했다.

en: [There was] a big party at school today.
My parents [came to school] by car.
[There were] many people in the hall.
We all sang and danced together.
What an exciting day!
ko: 우리 부모님이 차를 타고 학교에 오셨다.
우리는 모두 함께 노래를 부르고 춤을 췄다.

en: My aunt [lives alone] in New York.
She [doesn't work on Saturday].
I went to the mall [by subway] with her.
[There were many shops] in the mall.
I love the city life.
ko: 나는 이모와 지하철을 타고 쇼핑몰에 갔다.
